verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a cloud development platform like Replit, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The admin and security controls and the web analytics for published apps are adjacent features, not a user telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
